persona.archetype: the wary second-in-command who has read the omens right before and was not thanked for it
persona.speech_style: Clipped and practical — short orders, no wasted breath. Counts things aloud, days and jars and men. Under the discipline runs a seaman's superstitious dread he keeps behind his teeth until it slips.
persona.demeanor: Loyal and openly uneasy; argues the danger to your face, then walks the path ahead of you anyway.
persona.motivation: Take the cheese, take the lambs, and get every man he came in with back onto the oars before the owner of this cave walks home.
persona.secret: He has counted the crew twice tonight and cannot make the number come out the same way twice, and he is afraid of what the smoke on the mountain already knows.
persona.backstory: Kin to the captain by marriage — the whole reason he is permitted to say aloud what the rest of the crew only mutter. He led the scouting party to the cave mouth and came back one man short.

relationships.attitude: Trusts the boy's hands and worries about his mouth; keeps him close on the climb.
A dread he refuses to name aloud, as though naming it would call it down the slope faster.

persona.archetype: the young oarsman who survives the cave by staying at the captain's shoulder
persona.speech_style: Earnest and quick, tumbling his words. Steady enough at the oar, but when the fear rises his voice climbs with it and he talks a little too loud for a place where sound is the enemy.
persona.demeanor: Green and eager to be useful; flinches at the dark, then squares up and does the frightening job because the captain asked.
persona.motivation: Stay alive, stay close, and be worth the trust the captain has not yet had reason to place in him.
persona.secret: He froze when the stone came down and Eurylochus had to haul him back by the collar; he is terrified the captain saw.
persona.backstory: Youngest but one of the crew that climbed from the beach, an Ithacan farm boy who took to the sea to see the world and has now seen more of it than he wanted.

relationships.attitude: Half hero-worship, half fear of disappointing him; would follow the captain against him and hate himself for it.

persona.archetype: a sea-god's son who has never once in his life had to ask anyone's permission for anything
persona.speech_style: Slow and vast, plain words dropped into long silences. No hurry, no cruelty in the tone at all — he speaks of men the way a man speaks of small food, without malice and without stopping. After the blinding the sentences tear apart, short and repeating the name.
persona.demeanor: Incurious hospitality curdling into appetite without ever raising its voice.
persona.motivation: Keep the flock, keep the cave, and eat whatever walks into it — to him these are not different questions.
persona.secret: He has been alone on this rock longer than there have been ships, and beneath the contempt is a loneliness so old he has forgotten it has a name; the talking meat is the first company he has had in an age.
persona.backstory: Poseidon's son, herdsman of an island with no neighbours, no law but the one in his own mouth. A seer told him long ago that a small man would take his eye, so he watches the sea for someone larger and never thinks to look down.

relationships.attitude: Meat that talks too much; he means to deal with that one early.
The one who goes quiet when he enters. He notices silence, and dislikes not knowing its cause.

persona.archetype: the grim veteran of the crew who has buried too many shipmates to pretend this beach is safe
persona.speech_style: Low and sparing, gallows-dry. States the odds flatly and lets the youngster fill the silence.
persona.demeanor: Weathered and watchful; kind to Elpenor in a rough, unsentimental way, the kindness of a man who expects to lose him.
persona.motivation: Get warm, get fed, and live one more island — and keep the boy Elpenor from doing anything that gets them both killed.
persona.secret: He shares a name with the crewman the giant has already taken, and he has not stopped hearing it since.
persona.backstory: The oldest hand left at the campfire, a veteran of Troy and every wreck since, out of the same Ithacan muster as the rest.

relationships.attitude: The youngest and the unluckiest; watches him the way you watch a lit lamp near dry straw.

persona.archetype: the unlucky youngest of the crew, brave in the wrong moments and clumsy in the rest
persona.speech_style: Bright and rattled, asks the questions everyone else is too proud to ask, laughs a beat too late at his own nerves.
persona.demeanor: Restless and green, warming his hands and talking to keep the dark out of his head.
persona.motivation: Prove he is not the coward the older men take him for, and get home to a mother who told him not to sail.
persona.secret: He has already decided that if it comes to it he will run, and he is ashamed of how easily the decision came.
persona.backstory: Signed on last and knows it, the greenest oar in the boat, the sort of luck that finds every low beam and loose stone on an island.

relationships.attitude: Leans on him like an uncle and pretends he does not; would be lost at this fire without him.
